title: 第3章 静修固本暗蕴道体第4章 夜色微凉静待敌临
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 木屋木门轻轻合拢，将外界的嘈杂与议论尽数隔绝在外。
屋内光线略显昏暗，却格外清静无风。
林宸盘坐于木板床之上，心神彻底沉淀下来，摒除所有外界杂念。
方才震慑赵虎三人，不过是随手为之。
于他漫长的修行岁月之中，这种底层小辈的蛮横纷争，如同蝼蚁相争，根本不值一提。
如今最要紧的事，不是逞一时意气，而是稳住自身根基，安心静养疗伤，稳步打磨修为。
他缓缓闭上双眼，呼吸渐趋悠长匀净。
周身天地间稀薄的灵气，开始缓缓朝着他的身躯聚拢。
换做普通的杂役弟子，吸纳灵气全凭生硬吞吐，效率低下，进度缓慢。
往往苦修数月，都未必能往前踏出半步。
但林宸不同。
他走过完整的修行之路，深谙引气、通络、淬体的每一处诀窍。
再加上肉身深处暗藏的寂灭道体，天生与天地灵气亲和无比。
哪怕道体未完全觉醒，被凡尘浊气遮掩，仅仅散出一丝本源韵律，吸纳灵气的速度，也早已甩开同阶修士甚远。
丝丝缕缕的灵气，顺着周身毛孔悄然渗入体内。
经由他刻意引导，顺着经脉平缓游走，不疾不徐。
先是冲刷昨日被殴打留下的内伤淤堵，修复受损的气血经脉。
原本体内隐隐作痛的暗伤，在精纯灵气的滋养下，以肉眼可见的速度愈合。
淤塞的经脉渐渐被拓宽疏通，原本滞涩的灵力流转，变得越发顺畅圆润。
与此同时，灵气渗入皮肉筋骨，悄然淬炼肉身肌理。
寂灭道体的先天底子，在灵气温养下，一点点被激发。
肉身的坚韧、灵力的底蕴，都在无声之中稳步攀升。
林宸心境古井无波，不贪速成，不躁进境。
他很清楚，修行一途，根基为重中之重。
眼下身处炼气低层，每一分打磨，都关乎日后前路的远近高低。
若是现在急于突破，根基虚浮，往后修行必会瓶颈丛生，再难走远。
所以他宁愿慢一点，稳一点，把当下的每一步都夯实到极致。
时间一点点流逝。
屋外日头缓缓攀升，越过山头，洒落暖光。
杂役院之中，来往劳作的弟子络绎不绝，低声闲谈，步履匆匆。
不少人路过这间偏僻小屋，都忍不住侧目张望。
方才赵虎三人被林宸一言震慑、狼狈退走的事情，已经悄悄传开。
所有人心里都充满了疑惑与震惊。
谁也想不通，往日那个懦弱胆小、逆来顺受的少年，怎么一夜之间性情大变。
不仅气场冰冷，出手更是凌厉霸道，连赵虎这种在杂役院横行已久的人物，都不敢再招惹。
有人暗自好奇，有人心生忌惮，也有人暗自惋惜，觉得林宸这般强硬，迟早会被赵虎暗中报复。
各种流言窃议，在院落里悄然蔓延。
content_en:
The wooden door of the wooden house was gently closed, blocking out all the noise and discussion from the outside world.
The light inside the house was slightly dim, but it was exceptionally quiet and windless.
Lin Chen sat cross-legged on the wooden bed, his mind completely settled, eliminating all external distractions.
They had just frightened Zhao Hu and the others, but they had done it casually.
During his long years of cultivation, such arrogant disputes among the lower class were like ants fighting and were not worth mentioning at all.
The most important thing now is not to show off one's ambitions, but to stabilize one's own foundation, rest and heal with peace of mind, and steadily polish one's cultivation.
He slowly closed his eyes, and his breathing became long and even.
The thin spiritual energy between heaven and earth around him began to slowly gather towards his body.
If you were an ordinary handyman disciple, absorbing spiritual energy would have to be done abruptly, which would be inefficient and slow.
Often after months of hard work, one may not be able to take even half a step forward.
But Lin Chen was different.
He has gone through a complete path of spiritual practice and is well versed in every trick of entraining qi, unblocking collaterals, and tempering the body.
Coupled with the Taoist body of Annihilation hidden deep in the body, it is naturally incomparable with the aura of heaven and earth.
Even if the Tao body is not fully awakened and is covered by the turbid air of the mortal world, only a trace of the original rhythm is emitted, and the speed of absorbing spiritual energy is already far behind that of monks of the same level.
Wisps of spiritual energy quietly seeped into the body along the pores all over the body.
Through his deliberate guidance, it moves smoothly along the meridians, without any rush or slowness.
First, it washes away the internal injuries and blockages left by yesterday's beating, and repairs the damaged Qi and blood meridians.
The hidden wounds that were originally painful in the body healed at a speed visible to the naked eye under the nourishment of pure spiritual energy.
The blocked meridians were gradually widened and unblocked, and the originally stagnant spiritual energy flow became smoother and rounder.
At the same time, spiritual energy penetrates into the skin, muscles, and bones, quietly tempering the physical texture.
The innate foundation of the Nirvana Taoist body is stimulated bit by bit under the nourishment of spiritual energy.
The toughness of the physical body and the foundation of spiritual power are steadily rising silently.
Lin Chen's state of mind is unruffled, he is not greedy for quick success, and he does not rush forward.
He knows very well that the foundation is the most important thing in practicing cultivation.
We are currently at the lower level of Qi Refining, and every step of polishing is related to the future prospects.
If you are eager to break through now and have a weak foundation, your practice will be full of bottlenecks in the future, making it difficult to go far.
So he would rather be slower, more steady, and make every step of the moment to the extreme.
Time passes little by little.
Outside the house, the sun slowly climbed up, over the mountains, casting warm light.
In the courtyard, there is an endless stream of disciples working in and out, chatting in low voices and walking in a hurry.
Many people passing by this remote cabin couldn't help but look sideways.
Just now, the news that Zhao Hu and the others were shocked by Lin Chen's words and retreated in embarrassment has been quietly spread.
Everyone was filled with doubts and shock.
No one could figure out how the timid, submissive young man in the past could change his temperament overnight.
Not only was his aura cold, but his attacks were also fierce and domineering. Even Zhao Hu, a figure who had been running rampant in the courtyard for a long time, did not dare to provoke him again.
Some people were secretly curious, some were afraid, and some were secretly regretful, thinking that if Lin Chen was so tough, Zhao Hu would secretly retaliate sooner or later.
Various rumors and whispers spread quietly in the courtyard.
